reported_value: song (males, breeding/migration, sometimes feeding grounds), social calls in migrating groups, feeding calls/cries (cooperative feeding), feeding-ground social calls
proposed_distribution: EQUAL encounters per context: song, migrating social group, cooperative feeding (cries), feeding-ground social calls

reported_value: 61 vocal pods: mother-calf 12, adult pairs 8, mother-calf-escort 18, 3 adults 3, 4 adults 1, mother-calf + 3 escorts 4; groups unstable, frequent joining/splitting
proposed_distribution: group 2-5 animals (weights from these counts); 1-3 callers

reported_value: bouts = calls within 3.9 s; bouts more frequent when whales join a group and in multi-escort groups; grunts, groans, barks almost exclusive to joining pods; cries and underwater blows mainly in competitive groups; wops, thwops, snorts, grumbles general
proposed_distribution: social encounters: bouts of 2-10 calls with ICI <3.9 s, separated by silences lognormal median 3 min (assumed); joining events add a burst of grunt/groan/bark
source: Rekdahl et al. 2015 JASA 137:3042; Dunlop et al. 2008 Mar Mamm Sci 24:613

reported_value: 660 measured sounds from 61 pods (~11 per pod, sampled); repetitive types in bouts: grunts 5, croaks 4-5 (3-8), yaps 6-8, yelps 3-4, pulses 7-15 units
proposed_distribution: calls per encounter ~ lognormal median 30 (5-200) (assumed scaling)

reported_value: 299 analysable calls in 92.6 h over 32 days (~3/h analysable); calls per bout: growl ~1, whup ~1, swop 6+-7, droplet 5+-3, teepee 4+-4, horse 7+-5, squeegee 5+-10
proposed_distribution: rate ~ lognormal median 10/h (1-60) (assumed above analysable rate); bout sizes from Fournet Table IV

reported_value: groups of 5-11 whales; cries in series of 4.3+-5.1 (median 3) cries; cries 0.4-8.2 s; differ among sessions/groups
proposed_distribution: 1 caller (cries) in group of 5-11; series of lognormal median 3 cries every ~1-5 min during lunges (assumed timing)

reported_value: song = repeated themes; one song cycle typically ~10-20 min; sessions last hours (Norway feeding ground complete sessions 13-815 min; Atlantic, flagged); song-unit call types from Dunlop 2007/Rekdahl 2013
proposed_distribution: session lognormal median 2 h (0.2-13.6 h); song cycle 10-20 min; singer surfaces ~every cycle (silence 30-60 s, assumed); 1 singer (p 0.6), 2-3 audible singers (0.4)
basis: mixed: Atlantic session data + general knowledge + assumed
source: Tyarks et al. 2021 Front Mar Sci (Atlantic)
notes: find Pacific song-session data in v2

reported_value: breeding grounds (e.g. Hawaii) dominated by overlapping singers in winter (widely reported); not quantified in our sources
proposed_distribution: song encounters: chorus layer p = 0.5 (breeding season, assumed); chorus = many distant song units at low detectability

reported_value: song-unit social calls appear/disappear with each year's song; stable core of 12 types persists 11 yr
proposed_distribution: each encounter draws a 'song year' that sets which song-unit call types are available

reported_value: study area radius 10 km (E Australia); humpback calls detectable >50 km in surface channel
proposed_distribution: range log-uniform 0.2-30 km sets contour completeness, fragmentation and loss of upper harmonics (cries/shrieks lose high components first)
within-caller SD 0.3 x population SD (assumed); humpback population SDs are large so individuals still vary
